questions.imageAlt: Original JMAP Geometry question 22: Interior and Exterior Angles of Triangles.
questions.prompt: What is the measure of exterior angle KMN?
questions.explanation: The base angles at K and L are both 15°. The vertex angle KML is 180° − 15° − 15° = 150°. Its adjacent exterior angle is 180° − 150° = 30°.

questions.topic: Interior and Exterior Angles of Triangles
questions.imageAlt: Original JMAP Geometry question 23: Interior and Exterior Angles of Triangles.
questions.explanation: 3x − 22 + 4x − 18 = 6x − 23. Thus x = 17. The exterior angle is 6(17) − 23 = 79°, so m∠ACB = 180° − 79° = 101°.
